# VisuStella MZ Battle Core - Extended LLM Index

## Document Overview
This is the complete reference documentation for VisuStella MZ Battle Core v1.85, a comprehensive battle system overhaul for RPG Maker MZ. The plugin provides Action Sequences, animated enemies, damage styles, custom targeting, and extensive JavaScript notetags.

## Documentation Map

### Getting Started Section
**Location**: `getting-started/`

**introduction.md** (Lines 1-60)
- Plugin overview and purpose
- Complete feature list with descriptions
- Action Sequences, Animated Sideview Enemies, Auto Battle, Base Troops, Battle Commands, Battle Layouts, Casting, Critical Hits, Custom Targeting, Damage Control, Damage Caps, Damage Traits, Elements & Status support, JavaScript notetags, Party Commands, Weather, Battle Log, HP Gauges

**requirements.md** (Lines 61-75)
- RPG Maker MZ only requirement
- Tier 1 classification
- Plugin loading order instructions
- Core Engine dependency

**major-changes.md** (Lines 76-400)
Detailed list of modifications to default MZ behavior:
- Action Sequences execution model
- Action Speed (random variance removed)
- Animated Sideview Battler support for enemies
- Battle Sprite updates for movement/floating
- Change Battle Back in battle
- Critical Hit LUK influence
- Damage Popups formatting
- Dual/Multi Wielding individual attacks
- Force Action queuing
- Random Scope targeting
- Spriteset_Battle updates
- TPB/ATB battle actor shifting
- Weather in battle
- Base Troops system
- Damage Styles feature

### Reference Section
**Location**: `reference/`

**damage-styles.md** (Lines 260-380)
Pre-configured damage calculation systems:
- Chart with properties (Use Formula As, PH/MA Disparity, Stat Scale, Damage Scale)
- Style definitions: Standard, ArmorScaling, CT, D4, DQ, Lo, Pokemon, Minecraft, WoW, etc.
- How to create/edit custom styles via notetag
- Plugin Parameter selection

**notetags.md** (Lines 400-2400)
Master index of all JavaScript notetag categories with usage examples.

**notetags/hp-gauge.md** (Lines 411-455)
- `<Show HP Gauge: x>` - Visibility conditions
- `<HP Gauge Width: x>` - Gauge dimensions
- `<HP Gauge Height: x>` - Gauge dimensions
- `<HP Gauge Color: css>` - Styling
- `<HP Gauge Back Color: css>` - Background styling
- `<HP Gauge Gauge X: y>` - Positioning
- `<HP Gauge Gauge Y: y>` - Positioning
- `<HP Gauge Gauge S: y>` - Scaling

**notetags/animation.md** (Lines 456-488)
- `<Attack Animation: id>` - Custom attack animation
- `<No Attack Animation>` - Disable attack animation
- `<Motion: motion>` - Override battler motion
- `<Weapon Image: index>` - Weapon sprite index

**notetags/battleback.md** (Lines 489-509)
- `<Battle Back 1: filename>` - Background image 1
- `<Battle Back 2: filename>` - Background image 2
- Region-based battleback associations

**notetags/battle-command.md** (Lines 510-761)
- `<Add Battle Command: x>` - Add skill to command window
- `<Remove Battle Command: x>` - Remove from command window
- `<Replace Battle Command: x, y>` - Replace with skill
- `<Clear Battle Commands>` - Remove all added commands
- `<Custom Battle Command>` - JavaScript custom command

**notetags/targeting.md** (Lines 785-930)
- `<Custom Target Eval>` - JavaScript targeting
- `<Modify Target: target>` - Target modification
- `<Repeat Targets: x>` - Multi-hit targeting
- `<Random Target: x>` - Random selection
- `<Target Counter: x>` - Counter targeting
- `<Reflect Target: x>` - Reflection targeting
- `<Absorb Target: x>` - Absorption targeting

**notetags/damage.md** (Lines 1006-1151)
- `<Damage Style>` - Select damage calculation style
- `<Damage Cap: x>` - Maximum damage limit
- `<Soft Damage Cap: x, y>` - Diminishing returns cap
- `<Armor Pen: x>` - Armor penetration
- `<Armor Red: x>` - Armor reduction
- `<Healing Cap: x>` - Maximum healing
- `<Custom Damage>` - JavaScript damage formula

**notetags/critical.md** (Lines 1152-1212)
- `<Critical Start: x%>` - Base critical rate
- `<Critical Flat: +x>` - Flat rate bonus
- `<Critical Multi: x.y>` - Damage multiplier
- `<Custom Critical Eval>` - JavaScript critical logic

**notetags/life-steal.md** (Lines 1291-1399)
- `<HP Drain: x%>` - HP leech
- `<MP Drain: x%>` - MP leech
- `<HP Restore on Damage: x%>` - Self-heal on damage
- `<MP Restore on Damage: x%>` - Self-MP restore

**notetags/action-sequence.md** (Lines 1400-1506)
- `<Custom Action Sequence>` - Full sequence override
- `<Pre-Start Action Sequence>` - Before action start
- `<Post-Damage Action Sequence>` - After damage
- `<Post-Action Action Sequence>` - After action completion

**notetags/animated-sideview.md** (Lines 1507-1804)
- `<Sideview Battler: filename>` - Sideview sprite
- `<Sideview Weapon: id>` - Weapon images
- `<Sideview Weapon 2: id>` - Second weapon
- `<Sideview Weapon 3: id>` - Third weapon
- `<Sideview Weapon 4: id>` - Fourth weapon
- `<SV Motion: motion>` - Motion override
- `<SV Attack Speed: x>` - Animation speed
- Positioning and display settings

**notetags/enemy.md** (Lines 1805-2317)
- `<Size: w, h>` - Enemy dimensions
- `<Scale: x%>` - Sprite scaling
- `<Anchor X: x>` - X anchor point
- `<Anchor Y: x>` - Y anchor point
- `<Shadow X: x>` - Shadow offset
- `<Shadow Y: x>` - Shadow offset
- `<Frame Width: x>` - Sprite frame width
- `<Frame Height: x>` - Sprite frame height
- `<Sprite Smoothing>` - Anti-aliasing

**notetags/battle-layout.md** (Lines 2318-2341)
- `<Bypass Battle Layout>` - Ignore layout setting
- `<Bypass Battle Layout Placement>` - Ignore placement

**notetags/troop.md** (Lines 2342-2413)
- Troop size tags for maximum enemy count
- Troop comment tags for page conditions

## Search Strategies

**Find specific notetag**: Use grep with `<` tag name
**Find plugin command**: Search for command name in Action Sequences section
**Find parameter**: Search in Plugin Parameters section by category
**Find formula**: Check Damage Styles or relevant notetag category
**Troubleshooting**: Check Major Changes for behavioral differences from default MZ
